-- CA-40 verification
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status, rating, incumbent, incumbent_party, notes
FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'CA' AND district = 40;

-- All June 2 primary state House races for photo audit
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status
FROM house_races 
WHERE state_code IN ('CA','IA','MT','NJ','NM','SD')
ORDER BY state_code, district;
